function.arguments: {"reason": "The question asks only for a descriptive fraction within the treatment arm, not a comparison between arms. Even though the treatment arm is confounded with severity (sicker patients are more likely to be assigned to treatment), this does not affect the computation of the response rate within the treatment arm itself. The estimand is a population-level summary, not a causal effect. Therefore, the confounding does not invalidate the result."}
function.name: resolve_finding
